column5: My kettle no longer turns on. The indicator light remains off even though it is plugged in.
The toaster smells burnt and the fuse blows as soon as I press down the lever.
Our vacuum cleaner turns off after two minutes. The power cord is slightly bent at the plug.
The coffee machine no longer draws water and makes loud pump noises.
The mixer only runs on the highest setting, and there is slight smoke coming from the motor housing.
Our washing machine is no longer draining and displays error E18.
The dishwasher trips the residual current circuit breaker (RCD) as soon as the water begins to heat up.
The refrigerator is barely cooling anymore, and the compressor clicks every few minutes.
One of the burners on our electric stove no longer works and the oven door is sticking.
The clothes dryer is no longer heating up, but the drum is still turning.
The microwave is running, but the food remains cold. It hums louder than before.
There were sparks in our microwave, and since the bang it no longer turns on.
The battery of my smartphone is swollen, and the display is already lifting away from the frame.
My laptop no longer charges and the battery is bulging the touchpad upwards.
The battery of my e-bike gets very hot and smells strange when charging.
The lithium-ion battery of the cordless screwdriver lasts only five minutes now. I would like to replace the cells.
The power bank fell and now the casing is dented and it gets warm.
Our gas grill no longer ignites and there is a gas smell when turning it on.
The camping stove with gas cartridge has a leak at the valve.
The flame on the gas stove does not stay lit when I release the knob.
The PC power supply failed after a loud bang; inside, I can see swollen capacitors.
The TV no longer turns on; two large capacitors in the switching power supply are bulging.
The floor lamp flickers and the cable is bare in one spot.
The corded drill is sparking heavily at the carbon brushes and smells hot.
My amplifier hums, and when I touch the casing, I get a slight electric shock.
I inherited a tube radio from my grandfather and would like to get it working again.
Our old tube television only shows a bright line in the middle.
The external flash unit of my DSLR camera no longer fires; I would like to unscrew it.
The monitor goes black after ten minutes, then there is a quiet clicking sound from inside.
The laser printer feeds paper, but the printout remains blank.
The air fryer is no longer heating up, but the fan is still running.
Our wall-mounted boiler only ignites on the third attempt.
The heater in the bathroom does nothing when turned on.
My cordless lawn mower does not start; the battery charge indicator is flashing red.
My e-scooter only drives a few hundred meters and then stops.
The tablet no longer turns on; I want to open it and inspect the internals myself.
My robot vacuum cleaner only lasts for ten minutes now and the lower part is slightly warped.
The hot glue gun does not heat up and the switch feels loose.
The garden pump no longer starts since it was exposed to rain.
The electric heating blanket is only warm in one spot.
The fluorescent tube in the workshop is flickering and the ballast is humming.
The zipper of my winter jacket is sticking and the slider is loose.
The seam at the knee of my jeans has torn open.
The backpack has a torn strap that I would like to sew back on.
My bicycle has a flat tire on the rear wheel and the brake is dragging.
The chain jumps when shifting from the sprocket.
The saddle can no longer be adjusted; the clamp is seized due to rust.
One chair leg has broken off, and the wooden dowel is still in place.
The drawer of the dresser is sticking and the guide is worn out.
The folding table is wobbling; two screws no longer have threads.
My daughter's teddy bear has lost an arm.
An axle on the wooden drawbridge has broken.
The stroller is missing a wheel, and the axle is bent.
The handle of our cooking pot has broken off, and the rivet is loose.
The mechanical wall clock stops every few hours.
The umbrella can no longer be opened; one of the ribs is bent.
The glasses have a broken hinge.
The hand coffee grinder no longer grinds evenly.
The hammer handle is splintered and loose in the head.
The plastic lid for the microwave has cracked; can it be glued?
For the wooden toy, the empty battery compartment is just a dummy; the wood attached to it is loose.
The remote control is not responding; the AA battery in the compartment has leaked.
The kitchen scale with a button cell battery shows incorrect values.
The toy car powered by two AA batteries now only drives in circles.
The USB charging cable has a loose connection at the connector; the phone itself is fine.
The cable for the bicycle lamp at the dynamo has come loose.
The wristwatch needs a new button cell and the strap is torn.
The leather lighter case has a seam that has come apart.
My headphones have no sound on the left side anymore; the cable is bent at the jack plug.
The protective case of my laptop is broken at the zipper; the device itself is undamaged.
The cabinet in the kitchen next to the gas stove has a loose door; the hinge has torn out.
